newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Stokes County, N.C..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Stokes County, N.C..

text.p: SEALED BIDS will be received by the North Carolina Local Government Commission (the LGC'') at the offices of the LGC in Raleigh, North Carolina, until 11:00 a.m., North Carolina Time, on

at which time and place said bids will be publicly opened and read, for the purchase of not less than all of the County of Stokes, North Carolina General Obligation School Bonds, Series 1996 (the Bonds''). The Bonds shall be dated as of December 1, 1996, and shall mature annually on June 1 in each of the years 1998 through 2017, inclusive, in the principal amount of $400,000 per year.
The County has agreed in the resolution authorizing the issuance of the Bonds to comply with the continuing

disclosure obligations imposed by Rule 15c2-12 promulgated by the Securities and Exchange Commission, as described in the Official Statement with respect to the Bonds. The County has designated the Bonds as
Obligations'' under the Section 265 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended.

A bid must be for not less than all of the Bonds and must be not less than the par amount of the Bonds. Each bid must be accompanied by a certified or bank cashier's check or treasurer's check in the amount of $160,000, payable to the order of the State Treasurer of North Carolina, on which no interest will be allowed. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder offering to purchase the Bonds at the lowest interest cost to the County, such cost to be determined by deducting the total amount of any premium bid from the aggregate amount of interest on all the Bonds from their date until their respective maturities. The Bonds maturing on or before June 1, 2006 are not subject to redemption. The Bonds maturing on or after June 1, 2007 are subject to redemption prior to maturity, at the option of the County on or after June 1, 2006, as set forth in the Detailed Notice of Sale. The Bonds, together with the approving opinion of Parker, Poe, Adams & Bernstein L.L.P., Charlotte, North Carolina, Bond Counsel, will be provided at the expense of the County. Additional information, including the Detailed Notice of Sale, may be obtained from the undersigned at 325 North Salisbury Street, Fourth Floor, Raleigh, North Carolina 27603-1388.
